Intel: Python code with medium chunk size

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"chunk_max_size\":50,\"language\":\"python\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def first():\n    x = 1\n    return x\n\ndef second():\n    y = 2\n    return y\n\ndef third():\n    z = 3\n    return z\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.structure)
    println(result.metrics.errorCount)
    println(result.chunks)
}
```
